name: AlphaFloor EFB v0.1.0
body:
### Initial Release

* **Fleet Integration**: Deep dataref synchronization with the ToLiss Airbus fleet (A319, A320neo, A321, A321XLR, A330-900, A340-600).
* **Avionics Dark Aero Cockpit UI**: Responsive touch tablet interface rendered directly inside the 3D cockpit.
* **Wi-Fi Remote Tablet Streaming**: Fly with external tablets, iPads, laptops, or secondary monitors connected over your local Wi-Fi network.
* **Takeoff & Landing Performance**: Precise computation of FLEX takeoff temperatures, V-speeds (V1, VR, V2), trim settings, and runway distance.
* **One-Click MCDU Sync**: Direct transfer of takeoff performance data into the ToLiss FMGS scratchpad.
* **Built-in 7-Day Free Trial**: Full access out of the box with zero setup hassle.
